headline: Lenovo confirms Legion Go issues after gamers report bricked devices
summary: Lenovo acknowledges issues with its Legion Go handhelds. A faulty software update has reportedly bricked devices. Gamers face potential repair bills from the company.

headline: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: The creator of 3D-printed guns claims to have bypassed government software blocks. This marks a new front in the battle against regulators. Regulators aim to stem the tide of untraceable ghost guns.

headline: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over their rental listings partnership
summary: The FTC and Zillow have reached a settlement in their antitrust case. The case alleged a 2025 Zillow-Redfin partnership violated laws. The FTC had accused them of anticompetitive practices in rental listings.

headline: Robotaxis are real now — so is the pushback
summary: Robotaxis are expanding their presence in cities. However, public and political pushback is growing. Rules governing driverless services face fierce debate.

headline: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 Is Now Available to Watch Online
summary: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 is officially available for streaming. Fans can now watch the iconic comic arc adaptation online. It's accessible in 4K resolution and on Blu-ray.

headline: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
summary: Newegg offers a great deal on 32GB DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 RAM. This memory is highly recommended for AMD Ryzen gaming builds. It's touted as the least overpriced option currently.

headline: Get a 1,000W 48V Adult Electric Bike With 28mph Top Speed and 80 Mile Range for Just $275 Shipped
summary: A powerful 1,000W adult electric bike is on sale for $275. It boasts a top speed of 28mph and an 80-mile range. The deal includes free shipping, making it ideal for commuters.

headline: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
summary: CD Projekt Red confirms The Witcher 3's new expansion will feature more Gwent. Card game enthusiasts are celebrating the news. 'Songs of the Past' brings additional content to the game.

headline: Iran says it is 'fully prepared' to counter widened US economic sanctions
summary: Iran declares full readiness to counteract new US economic sanctions. The US refers to its latest measures as an 'economic D-Day'. Tehran asserts it has a strategic plan to cope with the restrictions.

headline: More than 70,000 social and affordable homes to be built across England over 10 years
summary: Over 70,000 new social and affordable homes are planned for England. Significant funding has been granted to regions like Greater Manchester and London. The extensive building program aims to complete within a decade.

headline: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
summary: The Lockerbie bombing trial has been postponed once again. New evidence emerged just three days before its scheduled start. This marks the third delay for the Libyan man's trial.

headline: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
summary: China's factories are rapidly scaling up robot usage. Over two million robots are now at work across the country. This widespread automation marks a significant, yet less publicized, industrial shift.
